# GoodNovel

> > GoodNovel is an online reading platform featuring romance novels, fanfiction, and web fiction with popular works from authors like Evelyn M.M, Ameerawrites, and Savannah Hart.

GoodNovel offers a curated collection of romance stories, including werewolf romance, mafia romance, second-chance romance, and forbidden love narratives. The platform features both original novels and fanfiction from popular series like Harry Potter and One Piece, with content available in multiple languages including Indonesian.

## Key Topics

- Romance novels
- Online reading platform
- Fanfiction (Harry Potter, One Piece, Hazbin Hotel)
- Second-chance romance
- Werewolf romance

## Popular Romance Collections

- [Popular Romance Novels](https://www.goodnovel.com/channel/Popular): Curated popular romance novels by GoodNovel editors, updated regularly
- [Short Romance Stories](https://www.goodnovel.com/stories/Romance-short-novels): Short romance stories readable in one hour on GoodNovel platform
- [Novel Online (Indonesian)](https://www.goodnovel.com/stories/novel): Indonesian language novel catalog with free online reading on GoodNovel

## Fanfiction

- [Fanfiction Collection](https://www.goodnovel.com/fanfiction): Fanfiction collection featuring Harry Potter, One Piece, and other series

## Book Reviews & Resources

- [Web Novel Resources](https://www.goodnovel.com/resources): Book reviews, rankings, trends and insights for web novels on GoodNovel
- [Best Romance Books 2025](https://www.goodnovel.com/resources/book-review/best-romance): Top 44 romance novels for 2025 including werewolf and mafia romance picks
